items.title: UberEats: Promo Codes, Discounts & Other Savings: $11.25 off $18+
items.why: Delivery platforms pairing with streaming promos shows how bundled non-card perks can be surfaced through in-app ad units.
items.summary_ai: Uber Eats is running an in-app offer of $11.25 off orders over $18 tied to a Netflix Gameday ad, with eligibility limited.
items.take: Delivery platforms pairing with streaming promos shows how bundled non-card perks can be surfaced through in-app ad units.
